_export.purpose: Corrected LifeOS proof workflow with the PR #53 idempotency contract adapted for n8n Cloud (Data Table claim store). This is the logical definition applied in place to workflow wMv71FmDq4aN5ZsE on 2026-09-01 (32 atomic operations, 0 validation warnings). Node ids for pre-existing nodes are the live ids; new nodes receive server-assigned ids on save.
_export.versionName: Idempotency closeout: durable Data Table claim gate (PR #53 contract)
_export.functionalSourceOfTruth: PR #53, merge 9895c4a805032f677a9acb90e4747669ed92bfc4 (lib/automation/idempotency.ts). FileSystemIdempotencyStore (O_EXCL) replaced by the n8n Cloud native Data Table 'lifeos_idempotency_claims' (id If9iZ2Y9nrf7jk6w) with insert-then-elect lowest-row-id winner semantics; fail-closed on quarantine, store errors, and store anomalies.

idempotencyContract.atomicity: Every delivery durably inserts its own claim row (monotonic auto-increment id) BEFORE any ClickUp mutation; after a 2s visibility-settlement window all claims for the key are fetched and only the execution owning the lowest row id processes. Near-simultaneous duplicates therefore agree on a single winner; all others suppress.
failClosed: Missing X-GitHub-Delivery header -> quarantine (no ClickUp mutation)
Claim insert error -> datastore_failure sink (no ClickUp mutation)
Claim fetch error, zero rows, or own claim invisible -> datastore_failure (no ClickUp mutation)
idempotencyContract.observability: Execution data shows exactly one of: Add Proof Comment (first), Log Suppressed Event (duplicate/quarantine), Fail Closed - Datastore Error (datastore_failure); claim rows in the Data Table are a durable per-delivery audit log.
